rules.rule: CRM, AutoStop App, Gmail and Telegram own live records. Manager keeps only technical refs and approved de-identified lessons, never raw records, correspondence, customer or vehicle identifiers, financial data, credentials or secrets.

Routes, skills and live schemas guide rather than dictate; knowledge supplies evidence. A request authorizes its in-scope result, not a new recipient, purchase, finance, destructive action or release. For a write, resolve the exact target, preserve unrelated state and verify the result; reconcile uncertainty before retrying.
Keep resumable state compact and preserve user work plus remote history. Reset, rebase, force-push, restart and deploy require an explicit current request.
